answer.reason: The verses naming Jachin only say it was set up and named, which the summary already gives, but the surrounding verses tell how the pillars were cast and later broken.

clauses.english: was cast in brass by Hiram of Tyre
clauses.quote: he cast two pillars of brass

clauses.english: was broken in pieces by the Chaldees, and its brass carried to Babylon
clauses.quote: did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon

doubts: The casting and the breaking are told of both pillars together; Jachin is not named in those verses, only in 1KI 7:21 and 2CH 3:17.
2CH 3:15 gives the pillars' height as thirty-five cubits, against eighteen in 1KI 7:15, so I left height out.
